newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs close off on heavy, speculative trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs close off on heavy, speculative trade.

text.p: Brazil stocks closed slightly lower led downward by steel shares and benchmark Telebras in heavy, speculative trade ahead of Monday's options expiry, brokers said.
"It was another volatile day. It opened strongly and stayed that way through the day," one broker said. "But at the end of the day, prices were knocked down with ease."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index .BVSP of 48 most-traded shares ended down 0.2 percent at 11,828 points on volume of 1.13 billion reais ($1.05 billion).
